propositions: Reconciler field asymmetry policy scattered across call sites lacks single enumerable contract; needs declarative registry enumerating each field's symmetry class (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate) with codec/gate references.

Property tests parameterized off field-contract registry must assert roundtrip identity only for declared-bidirectional codecs, merge idempotence + no-removal for add-wins, gate-consulted behavior for one-way-gated fields through real call paths.
Import-time coverage guard must fail test collection if any field handled by inbound_differ/apply_inbound_records lacks registry entry, binding new field additions to contract declaration.
Registry declaration must not refactor existing behavior—tests assert code matches declarations; rewiring call sites to import registry is out of scope.
Field contract registration pattern must be durably recorded in docs/architecture.md reconciler section so new call sites know convention.
